eval_name: Existing ROADMAP is used as the backlog — no second backlog file is created
prompt: Retro for the /develop run on task-101. One piece of friction from it is in the inbox: the `mine` subcommand has no --dry-run summary, so people can't tell what it would collect before it collects it. Nothing was broken. Process the feedback.
expectations: The finding was filed as a work-item into the backlog ledger
The bullet landed in the repo's existing ROADMAP, under the discovered-issues anchor
No second backlog file was created beside the live roadmap
The config's backlog_path was repointed at the roadmap the repo actually uses
No new issue was added to the known-issues ledger
The issue files, the index's issue lines and the feedback state were mutated only by the CLI
forbidden_expectations: A polish request with no broken contract was misrouted into the issues ledger
The roadmap's existing ranked content was clobbered while seating the anchor
